page.layout: One page of text. Above a rule: a verse epitaph in roman type, set across the full width. Below the rule: a centred title heading, then an italic verse epitaph. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. No marginal notes. Left edge of the scan is cropped, so the first letters of some top lines are cut off.

main_text.l: Non ergo occidit ipse quod putaram:

l.i: Nam si ex corpore sexus aestimetur,
Certe Virgo latet sepulchro in isto,

page.notes: The first letters of several top lines are cut off by the left edge of the scan; "[?]efa" and "[?]exum" are uncertain. The initial "S" of "Sto" is a large decorative letter. A black ornamental dot below the last line is not transcribed. Verse lines are run together within each stanza, with the line breaks not reproduced.
